learningContext.subject: biology
learningContext.topic: osmosis, bidirectional crossings, and net flow
learningContext.learningObjective: Distinguish net water movement toward a more concentrated solution from individual water molecule crossings in both directions in an idealized membrane.

conversationHistory.content: Two compartments begin at equal hydrostatic pressure and temperature. The membrane lets water through but blocks the dissolved solute.
